criteria.requirement: Integrate include_selectors/exclude_selectors into actual convert_soup. None include means the whole remaining tree, an empty include sequence means no content; accept a selector string or sequence. Work on a detached copy whenever selection is requested, apply exclusions before inclusions and truly remove excluded descendants. Emit selected roots in original document order, deduplicate overlapping selectors and ancestor/descendant selections by node identity, and preserve caller-supplied BeautifulSoup unmodified. Invalid selectors must propagate rather than silently selecting all. Keep default conversion and existing strip/convert tag-format semantics intact.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
